name: Brali
category: Evidence-aware practical knowledge library and machine-readable protocol dataset
project_center: Public knowledge layer for humans and machines
localization_status: English is canonical today. Future localized releases should preserve stable protocol identity, provenance, and explicit language metadata.

content_trust.indexing_rule: All public Growth Library entries are crawlable and included in the sitemap. Only reviewed and practical entries are included in the Trusted Protocol Feed and normal recommendations; pending-review and restricted entries stay visibly trust-labelled.

commercial_use.public_license_model: Non-commercial public use under the repository license; commercial use requires a separate agreement.

app.role: Optional application layer for applying Brali protocols through planning, check-ins, journals, time logs, and personal metrics.
app.data_storage: Personal app data is stored locally on the user's device.
